summary: Pakistani serial killer who in December 1999 confessed by letter to the rape and murder of 100 children and adolescents between 6 and 16 years old, mostly runaways and orphans living on the streets of Lahore. He was sentenced to death in March 2000 and was found dead in his cell at Kot Lakhpat prison in October 2001. Only two bodies were recovered: the remaining victims are known through photographs and notes he left with the police.
